briefdescription.para: A pair of the calling instruction (a call or invoke) and the call graph node being called.

detaileddescription.para: Call graph node may have two types of call records which represent an edge in the call graph - reference or a call edge. Reference edges are not associated with any call instruction and are created with the first field set to None, while real call edges have instruction address in this field. Therefore, all real call edges are expected to have a value in the first field and it is not supposed to be nullptr. Reference edges, for example, are used for connecting broker function caller to the callback function for callback call sites.

briefdescription.para: The number of times that this CallGraphNode occurs in the CalledFunctions array of this or other CallGraphNodes.

detaileddescription.para: removeCallEdgeFor - This method removes the edge in the node for the specified call site.
Note that this method takes linear time, so it should be used sparingly.

briefdescription.para: Removes all call edges from this node to the specified callee function.

detaileddescription.para: This takes more time to execute than removeCallEdgeTo, so it should not be used unless necessary.

briefdescription.para: Removes one edge associated with a null callsite from this node to the specified callee function.

detaileddescription.para: removeOneAbstractEdgeTo - Remove one edge associated with a null callsite from this node to the specified callee function.

briefdescription.para: Replaces the edge in the node for the specified call site with a new one.

detaileddescription.para: replaceCallEdge - This method replaces the edge in the node for the specified call site with a new one.
Note that this method takes linear time, so it should be used sparingly.
